summary: GraphHopper is a routing engine and library that processes OpenStreetMap data to calculate paths and directions. It provides core algorithms for geographic navigation and route optimisation tasks.
goodFor: It is well-suited for developers building self-hosted mapping services or logistics applications requiring direct control over geographical routing data.
watchOut: Memory consumption can be high depending on the size of the imported map region, and processing large OpenStreetMap extracts requires adequate hardware resources.
deployNotes: Because it is built with Java, you will typically need to allocate sufficient JVM heap space and place the application behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
